legend: You are given a zero-indexed array $$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$ of $$$n$$$ integers, each initially equal to $$$0$$$. You have to perform $$$q$$$ update operations on it. Each operation is described by four integers $$$l$$$, $$$r$$$, $$$x$$$, and $$$v$$$, and is performed as follows: for every $$$i$$$ with $$$l \le i \le r$$$, add $$$v$$$ to $$$a_{x \,\&\, i}$$$, where $$$\&$$$ denotes the bitwise AND operation.
Print the array $$$a$$$ after all $$$q$$$ operations are performed.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le n, q \le 10^6$$$) — the size of the array and the number of operations.

Each of the next $$$q$$$ lines contains four integers $$$l$$$, $$$r$$$, $$$x$$$, and $$$v$$$ ($$$0 \le l \le r \le n - 1;$$$ $$$0 \le x \le n - 1;$$$ $$$1 \le v \le 10^6$$$) — the parameters of one operation.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$10^6$$$ and the sum of $$$q$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$10^6$$$.
output: For each test case, print $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$ — the final array.
note: In the first test case, the array is initially $$$[0, 0, 0, 0]$$$.

The first operation has $$$l = 1$$$, $$$r = 3$$$, $$$x = 2$$$, $$$v = 5$$$. For $$$i = 1$$$: $$$2 \,\&\, 1 = 0$$$, so $$$5$$$ is added to $$$a_0$$$. For $$$i = 2$$$: $$$2 \,\&\, 2 = 2$$$, so $$$5$$$ is added to $$$a_2$$$. For $$$i = 3$$$: $$$2 \,\&\, 3 = 2$$$, so $$$5$$$ is added to $$$a_2$$$ again. Note that $$$a_2$$$ receives $$$v = 5$$$ twice during this single operation, once for $$$i = 2$$$ and once for $$$i = 3$$$. The array becomes $$$[5, 0, 10, 0]$$$.

legend: 给定一个由$$$n$$$个整数组成的零索引数组$$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$，每个整数最初都等于$$$0$$$。你必须对它执行$$$q$$$更新操作。每个操作用四个整数$$$l$$$， $$$r$$$, $$$x$$$， $$$v$$$来描述，执行方法如下：对于每一个$$$i$$$和$$$l \le i \le r$$$，将$$$v$$$加到$$$a_{x \,\&\, i}$$$上，其中$$$\&$$$表示位与运算。
在执行所有 $$$q$$$ 操作后打印数组 $$$a$$$。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数$$$n$$$和$$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le n, q \le 10^6$$$）——数组的大小和操作的数量。
接下来的 $$$q$$$ 行中的每一行都包含四个整数 $$$l$$$、$$$r$$$、$$$x$$$ 和 $$$v$$$($$$0 \le l \le r \le n - 1;$$$$$$0 \le x \le n - 1;$$$$$$1 \le v \le 10^6$$$)——即一次运算的参数。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 和不超过 $$$10^6$$$，所有测试用例的 $$$q$$$ 和不超过 $$$10^6$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印$$$n$$$个整数$$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$ -最终数组。
note: 在第一个测试用例中，数组最初为 $$$[0, 0, 0, 0]$$$。
